newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria bought additional 25,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Algeria bought additional 25,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: Algeria has bought an additional 25,000 tonnes of soft wheat for shipment in the first half of March, bringing its total recent purchases of wheat to 150,000 tonnes, European grain traders said on Thursday.
They said they did not know if the origin of the extra cargo was French or optional as some exporters said Algeria might seek a cash payment.
Traders could not provide price details.
Algeria has already bought 125,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for February and March shipment under a Coface-guaranteed export credit, traders have said.
The French wheat was priced at $178.75 per tonne, including freight and the cost of the Coface credit.
